CODE
Art. 2.3.69. 
Valuation of final assets and liabilities 
The final assets and liabilities are valued on the date of dissolution of the matrimonial property regime.
The value of the assets referred to in Article 2.3.68, ¤ 2, is determined on the date of the gift, fraudulent alienation or dissipation. The increase in value referred to in Article 2.3.68, ¤ 2, paragraph 1, 1¡, b), is valued at the date of the donation of the property.
 The values indicated in paragraph 2 are indexed to the change in the general consumer price index.
